Questions and answers

What is 救急医療キット?

In this glossary, 救急医療キット refers to: Sealed on-board kit containing prescription drugs and advanced medical supplies, used in-flight by qualified personnel for serious medical events.

How is 救急医療キット used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "タワー、着陸後に医療支援を要請します。前方キャビンで救急医療キットを使用しました。"

Definition

Sealed on-board kit containing prescription drugs and advanced medical supplies, used in-flight by qualified personnel for serious medical events.

Operational example

Tower, we request medical assistance upon landing; the emergency medical kit has been deployed in the forward cabin.
